attributes.experience:
Our team have experience in working/leading delivery of Cardano Node since Q4 2021 and owning of key Cardano projects , Chang, Plomin HFs from 2023 through Jan 2025
Close relationships built with IOG, Cardano Foundation, VacuumLabs and vendors to IOG during 2021-2024
Leading Delivery for Voltaire 2022 and subsequently head of Delivery for Cardano Node at IOG and subsequently at IOE thru to Chang and Plomin Hardforks, he worked closely with IOG, Cardano Foundation teams, VacuumLabs and Build and deploy of Sanchonet, CIP-95, CIP-1694 to facilitate onchain governance and wallet delegation via Demos Wallet. Coordinated all sanchonet releases through to hardfork Node 8, 9 and 10.

Additonal support from 2 team members have Haskell, nix and build experience of Wallet JavaScript, TypeScript and transaction analysis, optimisation and fixing.

attributes.maintain_and_support:

ZeeYuu.io would continue to support and see Community support for Daedalus roadmap and prioritisation
attributes.proposal_description:
# Outline Tasks #

## Upgrading infrastructure to avoid obselesence ##
- Upgrading of the node.js stack ensuring bringing security levels in line with similar more modern node versions

## Roadmap alignment to Cardano Node ##
- Optimising Daedalus for the full introduction of Genesis, from Genesis-lite
- Feature compatibility on core Daedalus to align with upcoming key Node releases on the UTxO HD LSM feature to move streamline mempool caching, this will lower the machine resources required for full-node for SSD and RAM
- Mithril Integration for light-client fast sync Integrating Mithril and reduce sync to less than 3hrs
- Enhancement of security in collaboration with cardano-wallet and the CF
- Enhancement of the DRep discovery feature to locate suitable DReps and their voting history.
- Incorporate Governance Actions viewing and provide alert notifications to ensure closing Governance Actions and status are tracked

## Technical Debt and Documentation ##
- resilience and security patching to ensure identified audit points are remediated and approved
- improved automated testing to reduce cost of QA and releases
- alignment with teams including Cardano-wallet to ensure consistent end to end testing performed on daedalus and hardware wallets
- provide a refreshed roadmap to bridge gap between Daedalus and available software wallets
- improvement of documentation and quality of support documents
- incorporation of Genesis enhancements as needed to support Cardano 2025 release roadmap
- Unique or active users have varied from 18k to 30k estimates since analysis was completed pre Chang-HF, these OG Cardano users need support 
- our intention with our team who have since 2017 working experience on Daedalus can support from Day 1 with skills to enhance and support.
attributes.key_proposal_deliverables:
Agreement on Service Level Agreement with IntersectMBO to align with key Cardano Node uplifts
Agreement on the key fixes which can be incorporated
Publishing of key work in progress and opportunity to focus on Technical debt, Security or Audit findings
QA and Approvals already undertaken for ongoing Cardano Node releases
attributes.resourcing_duration_estimates:
Multi-era experience from leading Delivery for Cardano Node at IOG, through leading delivery of “Age of Voltaire” and Chang and Plomin Hardforks, working closely with IOG, CF wallets teams, VacuumLabs and Software wallets for all aspects of on-chain Governance gaining a low level understanding Coordinated the 1st release of CIP-95, CIP-1694.  
Our developers have over 300 PRs committed to Daedalus since 2017 with 3 developers, experienced with Daedalus since development commenced, with tech lead, design, build, test and deployment experience. Since Q1 2025, began partnering with IOG with view to Daedalus being community supported,  hands-on with Daedalus code.

Experience in Hardware wallet integration and 1st writing of Trezor and Ledger interfaces through to enabling for CIP-95.  
We emphasise our key selling point will be the ability to immediately make changes, provide coverage for end to end design, build, test and review integration of new work with strong relationships with Cardano Foundation Cardano wallet team, Cardano Node, Vacuum Labs and Daedalus Community. 

Key experience in delivery of Genesis with close alignment with LSM UTxO HD optimisations for local node sync-ing. 

Our team members have skills in Haskell and Wallet design and build, JavaScript, TypeScript and Electron since Daedalus was first conceived in 2017.  

Team acknowledge the key work here is value preservation, security, reliability and keeping aligned with upcoming Cardano Node releases enabling LSM, Genesis and Leios. 

Integrating of fast-sync features and upcoming Governance features will be key to ensuring Daedalus community is well-served. Available capacity will likely be pointed to automated testing, security reviews and resilience testing.

attributes.problem_statement:
## Headline ##
- Daedalus is Cardano’s full node wallet enabling users access to the blockchain and more recently ability to participate in full governance and stake delegation through a full-node solution. 
- This proposal seeks to provide ongoing support of Daedalus Wallet for 2025, including delivery of enhancements on Governance to ensure explorer and profile for DReps are integrated.
- Support for blockchain mempool enhancements will need integration "UTxO LSM" feature
- Addition support for Genesis and support for any necessary network level fixes
- Addition of support for Mithril signatures for faster sync time of Daedalus
- Address key development and support items with allocation of resources skilled in nix, JavaScript, TypeScript and Haskell. 
- Support the 18-23000 active users who wish to see UI based enhancements where agreed and seen as critical to value, decentralisation and Governance
- Maintain focus on security and address memory and package support backlog items
- Technical debt prioritised based on severity, compliance and upcoming key feature release of L1 (LSM, Genesis) and L2 supporting infra.
- With High Value wallets still sitting on Daedalus, it is important to have support for '25 and beyond
attributes.proposal_benefit:
# Key benefits for this * enhanced support * are as follows:

## Best in class Support ##
- With Daedalus OGs working on the development, Users will get the best support for the proposed budget "without a steep learning curve". 
- Team has experience in all aspects from design, development, hardware wallet  integration, cardano-wallet integration with over 300 PRs committed to Daedalus since 2017.

## Key Benefits ##
- The ability to incorporate an augmented *Governance Experience* supporting 
- * DRep search functionality * - presently cut and paste
- * DRep profile viewing * - incorporate ability to view DReps profile on Social Media
- * Upcoming Votes integration * - ability to preview upcoming Governance Actions
- * Engineering Readiness * - ability to deliver value on budget without 'technical ramp-up'
- * Familiar with Product * - working relationship with partners, product and vendors

## Value Add ##
- Ability to incorporate key pipeline items and understand the possible challenges in advance 
- History of resolving issues of the past and making the most of available budget
- Optimised to support the Daedalus Community with a view to longevity

## Why are we doing this ##
- Continued value preservation and security applied under priority and threat assessment
- Daedalus Users across post Byron era receive additional features based on budget and criticality
- Innovation on Voting Feature to allow Governance Action voting via Daedalus must continue
- Ensure longevity, support and full node capability for estimated 18-30k users as measure pre Chang + Plomin Hardforks of Q3 ‘24 and Q1 ‘25
- Fairness of Participation - for selection of Delegated Representatives (DReps)
- Retention of a key group of wallet users - full node wallet folks
- Ensure updates which are related to maintenance avoiding product being obsolete
- Ensure original Cardano Wallet provides continuity for OG participants of Cardano
- Incorporate what Layer 2 has to offer once this beings appropriate and adds value

## Our proposal retains Daedalus as an uptodate full-node wallet, supporting decentralization, securing value for an important user segment in the Cardano ecosystem. ##

TL;dr - Security, Continuity, Transparency, Safeguarding of Value
attributes.supplementary_endorsement: WIth go-live of Chang and Plomin it has been evidenced that considerable amount of value resides in Daedalus wallets, this community have long term allegiance to Cardano Blockchain and have issues which could improve the experience and safety of this value can be remediated with support of IntersectMBO
attributes.explain_proposal_roadmap:
New augmentation of the Cardano Node needs to support not only software wallets but backward compatibility and a large proportion of value still sitting in older eras
Dedicated support to respond and catch up with new initiatives supporting staking, restaking, self-custody apply to Daedalus and are compliant with the Product Roadmap
Opportunity to bridge key features or provide tactical solutions to ensure value help is protected and earns rewards for the Wallet users
Keep pace with advancements and ensure walletholders are included in Cardano Community

attributes.proposal_description:
# Outline Tasks #

## Upgrading infrastructure to avoid obselesence ##
- Upgrading of the node.js stack ensuring bringing security levels in line with similar more modern node versions

## Roadmap alignment to Cardano Node ##
- Optimising Daedalus for the full introduction of Genesis, from Genesis-lite
- Feature compatibility on core Daedalus to align with upcoming key Node releases on the UTxO HD LSM feature to move streamline mempool caching, this will lower the machine resources required for full-node for SSD and RAM
- Mithril Integration for light-client fast sync Integrating Mithril and reduce sync to less than 3hrs
- Enhancement of security in collaboration with cardano-wallet and the CF
- Enhancement of the DRep discovery feature to locate suitable DReps and their voting history.
- Incorporate Governance Actions viewing and provide alert notifications to ensure closing Governance Actions and status are tracked

## Technical Debt and Documentation ##
- resilience and security patching to ensure identified audit points are remediated and approved
- improved automated testing to reduce cost of QA and releases
- alignment with teams including Cardano-wallet to ensure consistent end to end testing performed on daedalus and hardware wallets
- provide a refreshed roadmap to bridge gap between Daedalus and available software wallets
- improvement of documentation and quality of support documents
- incorporation of Genesis enhancements as needed to support Cardano 2025 release roadmap
- Unique or active users have varied from 18k to 30k estimates since analysis was completed pre Chang-HF, these OG Cardano users need support 
- our intention with our team who have since 2017 working experience on Daedalus can support from Day 1 with skills to enhance and support.

attributes.comment_text: Could you please provide proof of '23000 active users' as well as define what 'active' actually means? thank you. Is there some more detailed rundown of specific high priority development tasks / most important existing backlog issues available somewhere? (i.e. things apart from integrating the most recently released version of cardano-node/cardano-wallet), cheers.

Personally, I am hesitant about how much we should invest in Daedalus, but there are people in the community who are desperate to use Daedalus, and considering that I know of scams that take advantage of Daedalus's slow synchronization and other issues, which have resulted in a total of over 10M ADA being sent to scammers (and all of which has probably been sold), it feels like this is a necessary expense.
If this proposal does not go through and Daedalus is abolished, I expect that at least several million more ADA will be taken in scams using that fact, and likely sold on the market.
Costing is inaccurate - if ADA to USD conversion is 0.74, then requested ADA should be 472,973

@Yuta - the proposal will take 2 shapes Governance and Core compliance. I am waiting for edit rights unfortunately and will outline this carefully. Agree this is a community we need to provide good support. We have folks who in total have 300+ PR commits to Daedalus.

@Yuta - I will be splitting out the value on Governance (location services for DRep and profile viewing) and also to Core 'alignment' ensuring we keep pace with Cardano Node (Genesis plus UTxO HD(LSM)) and optimisations (MIthril). We are having edit issues ATM but hope those resolved, additionally team has experience of 300 PR (commits since 2017) on Daedalus and understand the value-protection and security focus.

@Yuta - I would say this proposal based on leveraging OG skill of folk who have intimate knowledge of Daedalus and can 'hit the ground running' returns good value. This will focus on the key items and would ensure Daedalus keep up with Cardano Node post Plomin.
I have adjusted and thank you for your feedback

Based on the range of unique users and impressions taken in our work pre-Chang and Plomin, alot of value still exists with a range of OG users from 18-23k users; albeit unique users being variable. The key enhancements of 2024 were of course for stake delegation to ensure rewards are earned and could be withdrawn. The delegation being substantial should be provided with more fluidity and equally focus on security and patching is needed. Other benefits of fast-syncing are worthwhile. 
Being able to bring a team of OG developers who can return value without having a long arc of getting up to speed also makes this good bang for the buck (or Ada), thank you for your support.
